notice: Fictional data only. All tax-rule simulator values must be labelled synthetic unless using the separately scoped official AY 2026-27 estimator.

scenarios.name: Matching records
scenarios.expected: No finding when payer, reference, period, category and amount match.

scenarios.name: Conflicting income values
scenarios.expected: Display ₹15,000 difference and ask the user to verify source evidence.

scenarios.name: Corrected employer statement
scenarios.expected: Preserve both versions and allow restoring the original.

scenarios.name: Missing deduction evidence
scenarios.expected: Mark evidence as required; do not auto-accept claim.

scenarios.name: Invalid or duplicate data
scenarios.expected: Flag duplicates and reject negative/non-finite amounts.

scenarios.name: Tax regime comparison
scenarios.expected: Show scoped new/old regime estimate, source date and limitations.

scenarios.name: Rule update
scenarios.expected: Compare synthetic versions without overwriting prior result.

scenarios.name: Failure recovery
scenarios.expected: Show error, retain manual input and offer retry/manual entry.
